CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pve_encounters (
        encounter_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        chat_id INTEGER NOT NULL, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, deadline_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', terminal_reason TEXT DEFAULT '',
        terminal_at TEXT DEFAULT NULL, mob_snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        CHECK(status IN ('active','victory','defeat','manual_escape','auto_escape','replaced'))
    )

Complete a matching ACTIVE BOSS quest after terminal victory claim.

    Normal and elite enemies are ignored. Both canonical boss_key and location
    must match. Progress preparation, reward and COMPLETED status execute inside
    the completion owner's single transaction. An empty production registry is
    a safe no-op and the normal RNG boss encounter policy remains untouched.
Mark the matched boss objective ready within completion transaction.

UPDATE user_story_quests SET progress=?, updated_at=?
        WHERE user_id=? AND quest_id=? AND status='ACTIVE'

Return a callable boss contract only for a matching ACTIVE BOSS quest.

    COMPLETED and SKIPPED rows are never callable because only the canonical
    ACTIVE row is considered. Consequently a successful kill, which Stage 19.19
    completes immediately, permanently removes the guaranteed call and prevents
    farming even if a stale Telegram button is pressed later.

Advance one region kill after a canonical terminal victory claim.

    The combat owner supplies only user and location. Normal, elite and boss
    victories therefore count equally, while concrete mob IDs are intentionally
    excluded. Empty production content is a safe no-op. The lifecycle owner keeps
    progress bounded and rejects non-ACTIVE, wrong-type and wrong-location quests.
